name: Abba
overview: The term 'Abba' reveals the intimate and personal relationship believers have with God as their Father. In Mark 14:36, Jesus Himself addresses God as 'Abba, Father,' expressing trust and submission to the Father's will. Romans 8:15 and Galatians 4:6 emphasize that through the Spirit of adoption, believers are enabled to cry out 'Abba, Father,' signifying their identity as God's children and the close fellowship made possible by the Spirit of His Son dwelling in their hearts.
